title: Company Vehicle Wraps in Ticino | VAM Deco
description: Company vehicle wraps in Ticino: turn cars and vans into advertising on the move. Durable materials, custom design. Free quote.
h1: Company vehicle wraps: advertising on the move
estratto: Turn your cars and vans into a mobile showcase: more visibility, more credibility and new customers, every day out on the road.

paragrafi: A wrapped company vehicle is a billboard that never stops moving. Every trip becomes a chance to get noticed, strengthen your brand image and reach new customers, with no recurring advertising costs.

sezioni.heading: Why wrapping your company vehicles pays off
lista: Constant visibility: whether on the road or parked, your brand is in front of thousands of people every day.
Professional image: a well-kept vehicle conveys reliability and makes your company look solid and organised.
Local reach with no targeting needed: you naturally cover the area where you work, from the city centre to the busiest roads.
One-off cost: unlike paid ads, a wrap keeps working for years on a single investment.

sezioni.heading: The types of vehicle wrap
paragrafi: We tailor the solution to your budget and the image you want to project:
lista: Logo and contact details: the essential choice, with your logo, phone number and website applied to the main panels.
Partial wrap: targeted graphics on doors, bonnet or rear window, understated yet eye-catching.
Full wrap: the vehicle is covered from end to end for maximum recognition.
Special films: matte, chrome or reflective finishes to get you noticed even at night.

sezioni.heading: Materials and durability
paragrafi: We use professional films and adhesives that stand up to rain, sun and frequent washing. Depending on the type and colour, a wrap keeps its colours vivid for roughly 5 to 8 years.
Application usually takes one or two days: the vehicle is deep-cleaned and the film is laid carefully for a flawless, long-lasting result.

sezioni.heading: Why choose VAM Deco in Ticino
paragrafi: We handle everything in-house, from graphic design to the final application. Premium materials, custom graphics designed to get your message across and a result that lasts.
Want to turn your vehicle into an advertising showcase? Get in touch for a free, no-obligation quote.

faq.domanda: How much does it cost to wrap a company vehicle?
faq.risposta: There is no fixed price: it depends on the type of vehicle (car, van or truck), the surface to be covered and the type of wrap, from a simple logo to a full wrap. To give you an exact figure we need to see the vehicle. We will prepare a free, tailored quote for you.

faq.domanda: How long does a vehicle wrap film last?
faq.risposta: Depending on the material and colour, a wrap lasts from around 5 to 8 years. The films withstand rain, sun and frequent washing while keeping their colours vivid over time.

faq.domanda: Does the film damage the vehicle's paint?
faq.risposta: No. When applied and removed by professionals it does not harm the bodywork. In fact, it protects the original paint from the sun's rays, keeping it from fading.

faq.domanda: Can I wrap a leased or rented car?
faq.risposta: Yes. The wrap can be fully removed at the end of the contract without leaving any trace, returning the vehicle to its original condition. It is also the ideal solution if you want to change the graphics in the future.

faq.domanda: How long does it take to apply the wrap?
faq.risposta: Usually one to two working days, depending on the complexity of the graphics and the surface to be covered. Before application the vehicle is deep-cleaned to ensure a perfect bond.
